jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(5)(G) inventory: Somerset School District, a town school district in the Windham Southwest Supervisory Union (member town: Somerset). Non-operating: tuitions all grades.
Windham Southwest Supervisory Union (official site; carries no Somerset board page).

board.post_note: Somerset SD: three directors at-large under 16 V.S.A. section 423(a). No memberships are minted -- see the source note.

sources.note: Somerset SD: the statutory town-district structure (16 V.S.A. section 423(a): three directors) is carried as the post, with NO memberships: no warning, minutes, roster, or board page exists for this district in any official source checked -- the Windham Southwest SU site (wswsu49.org) maintains board pages for its other five member districts and never mentions Somerset, and NCES lists the district with 0 schools and 0 students (the town is near-uninhabited; the district appears dormant, administered on paper through the SU office). Resolving documents: any Somerset SD annual meeting warning or minutes, an SU-published Somerset roster, or the district's AOE-filed annual report/budget.
